# 🛡️ Threat Assessment

## System and scope
Identify the code, workflow, or service being assessed.

## Assets
List code, credentials, data, permissions, and user trust.

## Trust boundaries
Add a diagram based on the actual system.

## Threat scenarios
| Threat | Entry point | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Residual risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Assumptions and exclusions
State what was not assessed.

## Evidence
Link source files, configuration, scans, and review findings.

## Actions
| Action | Owner | Priority | Due date | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
